rounds.text: Goldstar Power Ltd is significantly under-appreciated by the market, trading at an attractive price-to-earnings ratio of 6.71x compared to a sector benchmark of 26.55x [E1, E6]. The company exhibits phenomenal top and bottom-line expansion, delivering a compounded sales growth of 1632% and compounded profit growth of 1190% over the trailing twelve months [E14, E15]. Furthermore, a discounted cash flow model suggests an intrinsic value of Rs 34 per share, leaving a substantial 70.3% margin of safety against the current market price of Rs 10.2 [E32, E33]. The underlying business model is fundamentally sound and conservatively financed, displaying a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.05x with borrowings reduced to Rs 8 Cr [E27, E28], alongside a strong return on equity of 29.8% [E13]. Macroeconomic tailwinds strongly support this trajectory, as the Automobile and Auto Components sector sits in a verified tailwind with a score of +0.63 [E59, E61]. Conceded: operating cash flow turned negative at Rs -108 Cr in March 2026 and promoter holding has decreased by 11.59 percentage points over the longer term [E24, E30].

While the bull points to a low P/E ratio of 6.71x [E1], this multiple ignores an astronomical EV/EBITDA of 5935.37x against a sector benchmark of just 12.38x [E11]. Conceded: the company shows high sales and profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E14, E15], but these headline figures mask a severe deterioration in quarterly operating margins, which plummeted to 3% in June 2026 from 14% a year earlier [E20]. The DCF-derived intrinsic value of Rs 34 [E32] collapses under the weight of catastrophic cash flow destruction, where operating cash flow plunged to Rs -108 Cr and free cash flow dropped to Rs -111 Cr in March 2026 [E24, E25]. The bull's emphasis on a strong balance sheet overlooks a concerning cash conversion ratio of -3.72x and high debtors stretching to 176 days [E23, E50]. Furthermore, insiders are quietly exiting as promoter holdings have dropped by 11.59 percentage points since September 2022 [E30], and the stock carries a punishing historical volatility of 50.0% alongside an 80.4% maximum drawdown [E40, E41].
